name: Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt
description: Panty and Stocking are nasty angels who were banished from the pearly gates for being foul-mouthed bad girls! Now they spend their days hunting ghosts in the lecherous abyss between Heaven and Earth. Panty likes sex, Stocking likes sweets, and their afro-sporting main man Garterbelt has a fetish we can't mention.

videos.overview: The school is taken over by the demon sisters, Scanty and Kneesocks (the daughters of the mayor), and Panty and Stocking aren't pleased with the new changes they have made. Whilst Brief escapes with the Ghoststone powering the factory, Panty and Stocking fight against the demons sisters.

videos.title: Panty + Brief
videos.overview: After collecting the necessary Heaven Coins, Stocking manages to return to Heaven. However, due to her erratic sex life, Panty is forced to stay behind and redo her quota, with Garterbelt forbidding her from having sex. She and Brief go to a party, where a devious plan is being concocted by Corset and the Sisters, and Panty finds herself losing her angelic powers.

videos.title: Bitch Girls
videos.overview: Panty is kicked out by Garterbelt for the loss of her powers, but he secretly helps persuade her, with assistance from her grandmother, to stop Corset from using Brief to unlock Hell's Gate using Hell's Monkey. Panty has sex with Brief, breaking her hymen and restoring her powers. Stocking returns from Heaven and helps Panty take on Corset and the demon sisters.

videos.title: Bitch Girls: 2 Bitch
videos.overview: Brief falls onto Hell's Gate and accidentally unlocks it with Hell's Monkey, unleashing a massive Ghost that begins destroying Daten City. Corset fights and kills Garterbelt and proceeds to merge with the Ghost and try to invade Heaven. Panty and Stocking find a credit card hidden in Garterbelt's afro and use it to buy a device that summons their mother, who seemingly destroys Corset and forces the Ghost back into Hell's Gate, which is sealed by Chuck. Garterbelt returns to life in order to continue watching over Panty and Stocking, who are forced to remain on the surface again due to maxing out his credit card. As soon as they return home, Stocking promptly slices Panty to pieces, revealing herself to be a demon working with Corset, who respawns from Brief's penis.
